items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “You go talk to Britt Woodman... So I went and talked to Britt. He was really enthused about it. He said, “Yeah, go down there.”

ctx.x: So then what did you do? You got refused or rejected by L.A. City College.

Yeah. So then is when, after a while, we moved to Riverside. I started going to these sessions, started getting gigs, got the call to work the Post Office, and made plans to go to UCLA to finish my engineering studies. I went to UCLA, lasted one semester, and said, this is not for me. While I was going there, I had some friends – I was in a fraternity – I had some friends that were also interested in jazz. We decided we‟d go down to Central Avenue and see what was happening there, because that was still going on,…
Oh yeah. I‟ve heard that many times.
